items.title: Size Your Model to Where You Run It: Gemma 4 E2B and E4B on an AWS L4 and Two Small GPUs
items.summary: A 24 GB NVIDIA L4 serves Gemma 4 E2B and E4B at only 1.2-1.3x an 8 GB desktop RTX 3050 for one user, with the same answers, because a 4-bit small model uses 13-29% of the card. Pick the model for the hardware, and the hardware for the model.
